name: Tomato Classification and Legal Status
description: Tomatoes became increasingly popular throughout the United States in the early 1900s. In 1893, the U.S. Supreme Court considered the classification of tomatoes in Nix v. Hedden. The case concerned the Tariff Act of March 3, 1883.
